questions.q: Who was David’s firstborn son, and who was his mother?
questions.a: Amnon was David’s firstborn son, and his mother was Ahinoam the Jezreelitess.

questions.q: Who was David’s third son, and who was his mother?
questions.a: Absalom was David’s third son, and his mother was Maacah, the daughter of Talmai, the king of Geshur.

questions.q: Who was David’s sixth son, and who was his mother?
questions.a: Ithream was David’s sixth son, and his mother was Eglah, David’s wife.

questions.q: How many years did David rule as king in Jerusalem?
questions.a: He ruled for thirty-three years as king in Jerusalem.

questions.q: Who was the mother of Shimea, Shobab, Nathan, and Solomon?
questions.a: Bath Shua, the daughter of Ammiel, was the mother of these four sons.

questions.q: How many sons did David have in Jerusalem, according to this list?
questions.a: David had nine sons born in Jerusalem.

questions.q: Besides his sons, what other child did David have?
questions.a: David also had a daughter named Tamar, who was the sister of his sons.

questions.q: Who was Solomon’s son, and who was that son’s son?
questions.a: Solomon’s son was Rehoboam, and Rehoboam’s son was Abijah.

questions.q: Who was Manasseh’s son, and who was that son’s son?
questions.a: Manasseh’s son was Amon, and Amon’s son was Josiah.

questions.q: How many sons did Josiah have, and who was the firstborn?
questions.a: Josiah had four sons, and the firstborn was Johanan.

questions.q: Who was the last king for the Israelites?

commentary.text: —Of all the families of Israel, none were so illustrious as the family of David: here we have a full account of it. From this family, as concerning the flesh, Christ came. The attentive observer will perceive that the children of the righteous enjoy many advantages.
